    Jagatpura Overview

    Points to Consider

    What's great here!

    • Jagatpura is a mid-segment locality in South Jaipur, dominated by apartments, followed by land parcels

    • The locality is nearly 8 km from Jaipur International Airport via Sanganer Road

    • Easy access to major business centres, such as World Trade Park and Gaurav Towers, within 10 km

    • Nearness to NH 21 and NH 52 helps residents enjoy seamless connectivity across Jaipur

    • Getor Jagatpura Railway Station serves the locality

    • Anukampa Group, Unique Builders and Pearl Spytech are popular developers in the locality

    • Top educational institutes, like SRN International School, MNIT and Jaipur National University, are present within 10 km

    • Well-established hospitals, such as Jeevan Rekha Superspeciality, Narayana Multispeciality and Shri, are within 7 km

    • Jagatpura flyover is one of the longest flyovers in Jaipur

    • Newly built railway overbridges in Jahota, Sitapura and Bambala ease traffic movement in adjoining areas of Jagatpura
